hero.title: All your wealth, on one screen
hero.text: Link your accounts or enter them by hand. Net worth, allocation, fees, dividends and projections are calculated automatically.
hero.demoNote: The demo uses sample data and needs no sign-up.

preview.aria: Illustration of the app with made-up figures
preview.caption: Illustration, made-up figures

features.title: Everything you need to manage your wealth

together.title: All in one place
together.text: Banks, brokers, life insurance, crypto, property and loans: connected automatically or entered by hand.

allocation.title: Your true allocation
allocation.text: By asset class, region and sector, converted into your currency, with debts deducted.

fees.title: Your fees, in plain sight
fees.text: List what you pay and see what it costs over twenty years.

dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.text: Paid, confirmed, upcoming: the calendar of your passive income.

budget.title: Budget
budget.text: Income, spending, categories and savings rate, month after month.

projections.title: Projections
projections.text: A range of scenarios for your wealth, rather than one reassuring number.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.text: AES-encrypted access keys, read-only connections, export and deletion in one tap.

connectors.label: connectors: Europe, Emirates, global, crypto, broker

currencies.label: display currencies, including EUR, USD, CHF and AED

gesture.label: to export or delete your data

readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.text: Kenz reads your balances and positions. It cannot move money or place orders.

export.title: Export at any time
export.text: Download all of your data from the settings.

delete.title: Real deletion
delete.text: Delete your account in the app: your data and connections go with it.

closing.title: Take control of your wealth
closing.text: Connect your bank or enter a first account by hand.
